```{r}
Random <- function(nknotsx = 3, nknotsy = 5, dat = dataCC, model_feat = MODEL_FEATURE) {

  knotsx <- as.numeric(quantile(dat$x,1:nknotsx/(1+nknotsx)))
  knots_new_x <- as.numeric(quantile(dat$new_x,1:nknotsx/(1+nknotsx)))
  knotsy <-as.numeric(quantile(dat$y,1:nknotsy/(1+nknotsy)))
  shoe<-dat$shoe

  est <- NULL
  if(model_feat == 'NEW_X_NS_XY'){
    est<- glmer(n_Acc ~ ns(dat$new_x,knots=knots_new_x):ns(dat$y,knots=knotsy) + (1 | shoe),data = dat, family = binomial(link = "logit"), control =glmerControl(optimizer="nlminbwrap"))
  }
  else if(model_feat == 'CML_MODEL'){
    est<- clogit(dat$n_Acc~  ns(dat$new_x,knots=knots_new_x):ns(dat$y,knots=knotsy)+strata(shoe) , data=dat)
  }
  else { stop("Invalid model_feat value. Use 'NEW_X_NS_XY' or 'CML_MODEL'.")}

  cat("file_saving")
  file_name <- rac_new_output(P, rac_model_path(P, MODEL_FEATURE)) # never over a committed OLD model (A-075)
  saveRDS(est, file = file_name)
  return(est)
}

rand<-Random(dat=dataCC)
```
